name: divergent-ideation
description: Structured divergent thinking, creative provocation, and idea convergence for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Generate diverse ideas, break assumptions, and converge.
interface.longDescription: Move from a problem or rough idea to a diverse portfolio of options. Separate generation from judgment, apply multiple creative lenses, provoke hidden assumptions, then score and select the strongest ideas.
defaultPrompt: Brainstorm structurally different options for this problem.
Break the assumptions behind this idea.
Turn these raw ideas into a ranked portfolio.
